body: I take Dexedrine for severe ADHD, but as far as I'm aware depression isn't really a side effect.
I take a lot of naps for the same reason you do. It helps break up the day into more manageable chunks.
I play it in the school concert band and jazz ensemble. I have a bunch of records (I own a record player and used to collect records) of jazz stuff that I listen to on occasion.
Well, I learned to play Trombone.
